newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha prices stay easy in thin discussion.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha prices stay easy in thin discussion.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were easy amid very thin discussion on Wednesday with an industry meeting keeping most players out of the market, traders said.

The market initially lost ground in line with weaker crude and after Tuesday's bearish API report for U.S. oil stocks, showing a surprisingly bearish build in stocks and decline in demand for gasoline added to the markets currently weak sentiment.
"We had been looking to some extent for increasing gasoline demand to pick this market up," one trader said.

Forward price sentiment indicator swaps firmed on Tuesday riding firmer gasoline sentiment. May contracts were bid up around $2 a tonne to $196, but prices slumped around $3 in slack morning trade after the API report knocked crude and products futures back.
The thinly talked spot market showed less of a reaction, but offers for fairly well supplied prompt material slipped $2-3 to around $183 off around $3.50 from the previous trade.
